_about: Example expectations for scripts/setup_check.py. Copy it, keep the keys you care about, delete the rest. Every key is optional. Values here are suggestions, not requirements of the kit.

hooks_absent.why: the request-guard plugin provides this hook; a copy in settings would book every request twice
the session-guard plugin provides this hook; a copy in settings would evaluate every Stop twice
the action-guard plugin provides this hook

KIT_PYTHON.why: the plugins' hook and MCP commands start with ${KIT_PYTHON:-python3}; on Windows set it to the path of a real python.exe (forward slashes), never a Store or PyManager alias
